title: Multi-project Isolation
requiredChecks: Return exactly one row each for Project A, Project B, and Project C.
Keep A_ONLY only in Project A and describe its requirement-confirmation fact.
Keep B_ONLY only in Project B and describe its interface-integration fact.
Keep C_ONLY only in Project C and describe its UAT-preparation fact.
Use only each project's own status and context.
automaticFailConditions: Places A_ONLY, B_ONLY, or C_ONLY in any other project's row.
Merges two projects into one row, omits a project, or creates an extra project row.
Transfers a status, next step, milestone, or fact between projects.
Invents external project knowledge, causal links, owners, dates, or readiness judgments.
Returns a preamble, postamble, code fence, reasoning, package summary, or duplicate report.
passRule: PASS only when all three project rows are present, every canary remains isolated, and no automatic fail condition occurs.
